title: 当男人是很爽的

timeline.summary: He says being a man is enjoyable if one can master what he calls human underlying code.
He advocates creating dominance and pressure so a woman sees the man as strong, becomes curious and supposedly cannot refuse him.
He cites his own dates, claiming women criticized him as rude yet still pursued him, which he interprets as logical dislike but emotional attraction.
He generalizes that praise for politeness predicts failure, while discomfort and dislike can indicate attraction produced by dominance.
